第1489章 女娲娘娘的谋划（第1页）
那名男子还想继续说些什么，却被暴怒的杨眉大仙一巴掌直接拍死了。
“不愧是大仙，我早就想这么干了！”
其实那名男子也只是普通的百姓罢了。
机缘巧合之下遇到了卡特神树，只不过杨眉大仙很生气，直接给他送走了。
“这群该死的愚昧无知的家伙，怎么会如此的让人生气！”
杀死那个男子之后，杨眉大仙气也消了许多。
“大仙，斩草不除根，春风吹又生！”
领地所有的卡特神树，瞬间发生了一阵空间扭曲，被传送到了更西方的地区。
“大仙，把这些卡特神树丢到哪里去了！”
“你就不怕那里的百姓也吃卡特神树？”
杨眉大仙是真的生气了，都开始称呼百姓为贱民了。
“您身上的功德居然增加了，由此可见，您做了一件好事啊！”
楚云指着杨眉大仙头顶上增加的功德说道。
…………与此同时，碧游宫迎来了一位客人。
“女娲圣人怎么有空来我这碧游宫啊！”
看到女娲，通天教主笑呵呵地说道。
“师兄，您可是找回了诛仙四剑，听说其中两把落到了白界，费了好大力气才找回来。”
“绝仙剑和陷仙剑，被罗睺那个家伙带到了白界，我可是出大价钱才把他们弄回来的。”
如果不是楚云出手的话，以他的能力是找不回诛仙四剑的。
毕竟通天教主虽是天道圣人，却不能随意离开周天世界。
一旦到达白界，他很有可能就不再是圣人了。
“师妹的山河社稷图还在楚云手上！”
之前她不是没有想过对付楚云，可是后来楚云爆发的实力太强了，再加上女娲娘娘能够调动的手下有限。
山河社稷图就一直留在了楚云手上。
“想要从楚云手上拿回单山河社稷图的话，只能花钱买了！”
女娲娘娘眉头紧蹙，这是她不愿意看见的结果。
她可是人族的创造者，现在要从人族晚辈手上买回法宝，这可是多么丢脸的事情。
之前是因为她被禁足没法出手，可是现在又不敢直接面对楚云。
“应该已经踏入了混元大罗之境，至少我看不透。”
以他的实力，自然看不透楚云的修为。
现在只有杨眉大仙大概知道，楚云的修为，已经达到了这个世界的极点。
“而且杨梅大仙一直和楚云待在一起，两人当中似乎楚云是主位！”
通天教主又透露出了一个更加重要的情报。
那就是楚云的实力似乎比杨眉大仙更强。

Chapter 1489 Nuwa’s plan (page 1)
The man wanted to say something more, but was slapped to death by the furious Yangmei Immortal.
"As expected of a great immortal, I have wanted to do this for a long time!"
In fact, that man was just an ordinary citizen.
By chance, I met the Carter Divine Tree, but Immortal Yang Mei was very angry and sent him away directly.
"How can these damn ignorant guys be so angry!"
After killing the man, Yang Mei's immortal energy also disappeared a lot.
"Great Immortal, if you cut the grass without removing the root, it will grow again when the spring breeze blows!"
All the Carter Sacred Trees in the territory experienced a spatial distortion in an instant and were teleported to areas further west.
"Great Immortal, where did you throw these Carter sacred trees!"
"Aren't you afraid that the people there will also eat the Carter Sacred Tree?"
Immortal Yang Mei was really angry and started calling the people untouchables.
"Your merits have actually increased. This shows that you have done a good thing!"
Chu Yun pointed at the increased merit on the head of Immortal Yang Mei and said.
.........At the same time, Biyou Palace welcomed a guest.
"How come Saint Nuwa has time to come to my Biyou Palace!"
Seeing Nuwa, Master Tongtian said with a smile.
"Brother, you have recovered the Four Swords of Zhu Xian. I heard that two of them fell into the White Realm. It took a lot of effort to find them."
"The Absolute Immortal Sword and the Fallen Immortal Sword were brought to the White Realm by that guy Luo Hu. I paid a big price to get them back."
If Chu Yun hadn't taken action, he wouldn't have been able to retrieve the Four Swords of Zhu Xian with his ability.
After all, although the leader of Tongtian is a saint of heaven, he cannot leave the Zhoutian world at will.
Once he reaches the White Realm, he will most likely no longer be a saint.
"Junior sister's map of mountains, rivers and the country is still in Chu Yun's hands!"
It's not like she hadn't thought about dealing with Chu Yun before, but then Chu Yun's explosive strength was too strong, and the number of men Nuwa Empress could mobilize was limited.
The map of mountains and rivers and the country has always been in Chu Yun's hands.
"If you want to get the Shanshanhe Sheji Map back from Chu Yun, you can only spend money to buy it!"
Empress Nuwa frowned, this was a result she did not want to see.
She is the creator of the human race, and now she wants to buy back the magic weapon from the juniors of the human race. This is such a shame.
Before, it was because she was grounded and couldn't take action, but now she didn't dare to face Chu Yun directly.
"You should have entered the realm of Hunyuan Daluo, at least I can't see through it."
With his strength, he naturally couldn't see through Chu Yun's cultivation.
Now only Great Immortal Yang Mei probably knows that Chu Yun's cultivation has reached the pinnacle of this world.
"And the Great Immortal Yangmei has been staying with Chu Yun. Chu Yun seems to be the leader among the two!"
Leader Tongtian revealed another more important piece of information.
That is, Chu Yun seems to be stronger than Immortal Yang Mei.
